name: The Pentland Hotel
accommodation: Hotel rooms and bed and breakfast (room count not stated)
suitableFor: Travellers wanting a central hotel with bar and restaurant
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, bar, two lounges, night porter, early continental breakfast
overview: The Pentland Hotel is on Princes Street in the centre of Thurso, close to shops and public transport. It offers rooms on a bed-and-breakfast basis, with a restaurant and bar, two lounges and a night porter. Early risers can have a continental breakfast.
surfTripFit: Its central position keeps the river-mouth reef at Thurso East within easy reach, and the early breakfast suits dawn sessions.
